title: Rocket to the Moon

pages.title: Our moon adventure
pages.caption: A pretend mission begins.
pages.speech: Ari and Pip packed for a pretend moon adventure. Helmets, gloves, and a picnic! Their rocket waited under the stars. Where shall we go first?
pages.art: Child Ari with curly dark hair in white teal spacesuit, small round orange robot Pip, red white rocket, starry launch pad.

pages.title: Count down
pages.caption: Three, two, one… lift off!
pages.speech: Ari checked the seat belts. Pip checked the map. Three, two, one, lift off! Their pretend rocket rose into the sparkling night.
pages.art: Same rocket lifts gently from launch pad with soft orange plume; Ari and Pip visible in round window.

pages.title: Hello, Earth
pages.caption: Our home looks blue and white.
pages.speech: Through the window, Earth looked blue and white. That is our home, said Ari. Pip drew a little heart beside it on the map.
pages.art: Ari and orange robot look through rocket window at blue white Earth, dark space.

pages.title: A gentle landing
pages.caption: The moon has no air to breathe.
pages.speech: They landed gently. The real moon has no air to breathe, so astronauts need spacesuits. Ari and Pip kept their pretend helmets closed.
pages.art: Rocket landed on grey moon; child in sealed helmet and small robot step down ladder, Earth distant.

pages.title: Moon steps
pages.caption: Hop, pause, look!
pages.speech: Moon gravity is weaker than Earth's. Ari imagined a long slow hop. Hop, pause, look! Pip followed a trail of round footprints.
pages.art: Child in sealed spacesuit makes small playful hop on moon, robot and footprints, rocket nearby.

pages.title: What made that crater?
pages.caption: A bowl-shaped hollow in the ground.
pages.speech: They found a crater, a big hollow in the ground. Space rocks made many moon craters. Ari looked from a safe spot and sketched its shape.
pages.art: Ari and robot observe rounded crater from safe flat edge, sketch pad, rocket in distance.

pages.title: A message home
pages.caption: We are coming back!
pages.speech: Inside the rocket, Ari sent a message home. We saw craters and imagined moon hops! Pip saved their pictures. Now it was time to return.
pages.art: Child and orange robot inside warm rocket cabin press blue radio button, moon visible through window.

pages.title: Home under the stars
pages.caption: What would you explore next?
pages.speech: Their pretend mission ended with a picnic at home. The moon shone above them. Next time, said Ari, let us imagine another adventure.
pages.art: Ari without spacesuit and small orange toy robot on garden picnic blanket, cardboard rocket, moon overhead.

notes: Original story and illustrations; all family profiles can read it.
